title: D-078 slice 2a: site-definition mount hardening (DB-040 api preconditions a-e,i-l + n-api + flag-gated mount)
objective: Close the DB-040 mount-packet api preconditions on the accepted slice-1 site-definition substrate and mount the route flag-gated: swap the revoke status/binding check order so every cross-property probe reads 404 (no status oracle), rebind revoke on the stored record's condo_key without requiring a live multi-lot resolution (degraded resolver must not block the only human withdrawal path - D-051 fail-direction), add length caps (note ~2000, confirmer.name ~200, list-result cap), chain-depth/list caps plus a condo_key index, a record-id collision guard with typed refusal, a distinct error class for parcel-shape refusals (not invalid_confirmer), close the condo_key None write/read asymmetry, enforce the SITE_DEFINITION_STATUS_STATE_MATRIX on emissions, format/annotate the fractional-second timestamp ahead of the decimal-gated records section, and close the G4 A-1..A-8 api test items; then add the flag-gated mount line in main.py (default OFF in production until B-001 auth; the DB-040(f) read-authorization posture stays deferred behind the flag)
business_reason: The refusal copy shipped by the accepted substitution stamp names site confirmation as the next step; this packet makes the record substrate mountable so the confirm slice can follow, closing the security preconditions the T059 wave priced before any mount line
inputs: CHECKPOINT ENVELOPE (binding): in every checkpoint, OMIT the four envelope fields entirely - the controller fills them. If you supply one it must be EXACT full-length (40-hex SHA, FULL worktree path).

COMMAND CWD (binding): run ruff + api pytest from services/api (`cd services/api` first; cwd persists; `cd ../..` before the modularity check from repo root). Never chain onto a documented command.

SCOPE (binding; the findings ARE the spec - read docs/DISCOVERY_BACKLOG.md DB-040 row + project-control/reports/M5-T059-G3.md / M5-T059-G4.md / M5-T059-G5.md finding sections FIRST): close the DB-040 mount preconditions in the site_definition surface: (a) revoke checks BINDING (condo_key match) before STATUS so every cross-property probe reads 404, never a 409 status oracle; (b) revoke binds on the STORED record's condo_key without requiring a live multi-lot resolution - a degraded resolver must never block withdrawal (D-051 fail-direction; degraded-case tests); (c) length caps: note <=2000, confirmer.name <=200, bounded list results; (d) supersession chain-depth cap + list caps + a condo_key index replacing the O(n2) scan; (e) _record_insert collision guard (typed refusal on an existing id); (i) parcel-shape refusals get their OWN error class (never invalid_confirmer); (j) close the condo_key None write/read asymmetry + test; (k) enforce SITE_DEFINITION_STATUS_STATE_MATRIX on every emission; (l) format/annotate the fractional-second timestamp ahead of the decimal-gated records section; (n) the G4 A-1..A-8 api items THAT LIVE IN THIS SURFACE (flag-off sentinel on all routes, streaming-413 branch, entered!=billing fixture, named 298-Wallabout fixture exercised end-to-end, frozen-ness/isolation gaps, replace brittle substring guards); THEN the flag-gated mount line in main.py, default OFF (the DB-040(f) read-auth posture stays deferred BEHIND the flag - never mount unauthenticated-on in production config).

PRESERVATION (binding): app/api/v1/condo_records.py, app/connectors/**, app/rules/**, app/scenario/**, app/spatial/**, app/profile/**, every other route file, packages/contracts/**, apps/web/** are READ-ONLY; the M5-T060 lane holds the apps/web proposal-editor surface and the M5-T063 lane holds the web condo surface - touch NOTHING of either; the accepted slice-1 record semantics (revocable/supersedable, honest unconfirmed refusal) stay; no new dependency; no new flag beyond the ONE mount flag; modularity - check --report before growing any file past its tier.

outputs: Mount-hardened site-definition api: no cross-property oracle, degraded-resolver-safe revoke, caps/index/collision guards, typed parcel-shape refusals, matrix-enforced emissions, closed G4 api items
The flag-gated mount line (default OFF) making the confirm slice contractable
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (no oracle): a revoke probe against a record belonging to a DIFFERENT condo returns 404 regardless of the record's status; the 409-class response is reachable only for the record's OWN condo binding (order bound by test).

AS-2 (degraded-safe revoke): with the resolver returning multi-lot/unresolved/typed-error, revoking an EXISTING confirmation still succeeds on the stored condo_key (D-051 fail-direction tests each degraded class).

AS-3 (caps/guards): note>2000, name>200, over-cap lists, chain past the depth cap, and an id collision each refuse typed WITHOUT touching store state; the condo_key index removes the O(n2) scan (lookup path asserted).

AS-4 (typed shape refusals + matrix): parcel-shape defects refuse under their own error class; every emission conforms to SITE_DEFINITION_STATUS_STATE_MATRIX (enforcement test); the condo_key None asymmetry is closed both directions.

AS-5 (mount): with the flag OFF the app boots byte-identically (route absent from openapi, 404 sentinel on all site_definition paths); with the flag ON in tests the mounted routes serve; production default stays OFF pending B-001 auth (asserted from config).

AS-6 (preservation): full api suite + condo_records suite green; ruff clean; modularity exit 0; CI green at the pushed head; the accepted slice-1 semantics unchanged except where a DB-040 item legitimately narrows (each named in the report).
risks: main.py is the whole-app mount surface: anything beyond the one flag-gated include line + import is out of scope and fails review.
The M5-T063 lane holds the web condo surface and M5-T060 holds the proposal-editor web surface - G0 records three-way disjointness; touch neither.
DB-040(f) read-auth is DEFERRED behind the flag - mounting default-ON would ship self-attested personal data unauthenticated.
Fail-direction on revoke must follow D-051: refusing withdrawal on a degraded resolver is the WRONG direction and fails the wave.
